final: WITH per_rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) as avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_fee_to_duration FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_to_duration) as overall_avg_fee_to_duration FROM per_rating_stats), filtered_ratings AS (SELECT prs.avg_length, prs.avg_fee_to_duration, (prs.avg_fee_to_duration - oa.overall_avg_fee_to_duration) as diff FROM per_rating_stats prs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE prs.avg_fee_to_duration > oa.overall_avg_fee_to_duration) SELECT AVG(avg_length) as avg_running_time, AVG(avg_fee_to_duration) as avg_fee_to_duration_avg, AVG(diff) as avg_difference FROM filtered_ratings
